critic.reading: scale the count to the panel before comparing
critic.note: uniform scaling assumes panel sites register new substitutions; claim file C's correction puts the swept site on the panel in 8.8-24.7% of completions (1,376-3,836 at 15,556). Which share applies is M-301 (simulation), not this record

notes: All genome-wide counts reproduce (15,556; 630; 13,020). Against the panel the denominator decides: 630 scales to 5.2 on the 1,233,013-SNP panel, so 21 observed is 4x above, not 30x below; 15,556 and 13,020 scale uniformly to 5.7 and 4.8 on the 1,143,671-SNP panel, a scaling claim file C itself corrects to 1,376-3,836 panel-registered completions. The uniform figures are a lower bound on what the panel can see for selected completions, not the expectation.
